name: fr24_node
description: The nearest tracked aircraft from a Flightradar24 feeder on your network: callsign, altitude and when it was last heard, plus the airline, route and aircraft type from adsbdb.com and the airline's logo from soaringsymbols.org. Lower aircraft win, since nearness counts altitude as well as ground distance.

cell_options.name: node_url
cell_options.label: Radar node
cell_options.help: The feeder's flights.json address, usually http://<feeder>:8754/flights.json.

cell_options.name: home_lat
cell_options.label: Latitude
cell_options.help: Where you're watching from, in decimal degrees (north is positive).

cell_options.name: home_lon
cell_options.label: Longitude
cell_options.help: Decimal degrees, east is positive, so west of Greenwich is negative.
